neighbours.label: additive or parallel marker linking to something already said (also, the same, equally, just as)
fire: She plays the violin, and she also sings in the church choir.
The new library is beautiful, but the same cannot be said of the parking.
He was a gifted painter and was equally talented as a poet.
The town has a lovely beach, and it also offers good hiking trails.
My brother loves spicy food, and I also enjoy a hot curry now and then.
The first chapter was slow, and the second was just as dull.
Our team won the cup, and we were also named the fairest club.
The rules apply to managers, and they equally apply to new staff.
quiet: She plays the violin, but she rarely sings in the church choir.
The new library is beautiful, but the parking is a real disaster.
He was a gifted painter but never managed to write a single poem.
The town has a lovely beach, but it offers few hiking trails.
My brother loves spicy food, but I usually avoid a hot curry.
The first chapter was slow, but the second was quite exciting.
Our team won the cup, though we were fined for rough play.
The rules apply to managers, but new staff have different ones.

notes: Card: ' also' x13, ' same' x5, ' further', ' equally'; logit effect suppresses also/aussi/также/additionally.
